verdict.rationale: Terraform's docs say plans can be saved with `-out=FILE`, and `terraform show -json` then gives a JSON representation of the plan, configuration and current state. `terraform plan -json` also streams machine-readable JSON UI messages one per line, so an agent can parse a proposed change directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents parsing the plan JSON, since all evidence is first-party docs.
